name: Archivist Corbin Finch
description: A slight, pale man in his fifties with ink-stained fingers and eyes perpetually strained from reading psychic imprints. He wears thick-lensed glasses and moves with a nervous, bird-like quickness.
background: A low-level academic historian of the occult, Finch stumbled upon a genuine Warden artifact. His natural, untrained talent for psychometry allowed him to decipher it, bringing him to the faction's attention—and under its control.
goals: To fully catalogue and understand the nature of the 'unlikely guardian,' believing its unique connection holds the key to a more permanent solution than brute-force rituals, though he dare not voice this openly.
